name: Suji Halwa
description: Classic suji halwa with semolina toasted in ghee and cooked with a fragrant sugar syrup, cardamom and nuts.
method: Heat the water with sugar and cardamom until the sugar dissolves, then keep the syrup warm.
Melt ghee in a heavy pan and add the semolina.
Roast on medium-low heat, stirring continuously, until the semolina turns golden and smells nutty.
Carefully add the warm syrup in stages while stirring to avoid lumps.
Cook until the halwa thickens and begins to leave the sides of the pan.
Garnish with nuts and raisins and serve warm.
